name: RoslynGate
description: Answers .NET symbol questions with Roslyn instead of text search: definitions, semantic references, type hierarchies, name search, and reload_workspace. Returns compact, deterministic JSON. Built for medium and large solutions; on a couple of projects the MCP overhead can cost more than it saves. Opening a solution runs MSBuild evaluation, which can execute logic defined by the repository. It does not edit files or run tests. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: All five tools are read-only and return JSON; the server does not edit files or run tests.
It evaluates the solution with MSBuild, which can execute tasks and targets defined by the repository. Only open solutions you trust; treat project files as code.

Guard matches this entry by package name, so the launch stays on roslyngate. To run a fixed release, configure the server as npx -y roslyngate@0.2.2; the selector changes the installed version, not the matched package.
The .cs watcher is on by default and applies edits incrementally; pass --no-watch to disable it.
If the workspace changed on disk, a call can return stale=true with empty results. Call reload_workspace and retry; that is not a missing symbol.
